Overview

Karen is a city in Nairobi with a population of 80,000. An affluent suburb of Nairobi, known for the Karen Blixen Museum, luxury homes, and the Nairobi National Park. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 250 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 20.0.
